load_terminal_transfer.actual_AGND_strategy: Three source-defined25-via main-land arrays per half are required: surface ground pours left each main land attached only to its own isolated same-net zone. All lands, GH contacts and intended bypass returns must share the transitive native main AGND component; native AGND edge count must be zero. A pad+same-net-zone relation alone is insufficient.
load_terminal_transfer.electrical_acceptance_status: NOT ACCEPTED #38: complete native AGND/direct bypass topology is a draft checkpoint only. Authoritative common <=0.5mOhm and GH <=0.5A extraction, every fitted rail feed, actual rail <=1mOhm and hot distribution <=20mV remain unresolved; physical/process qualification NOT RUN #65.
load_terminal_transfer.external_array_fit: Unchanged 4x4 mm copper land and 5x5 mm courtyard do not fit a 0.7 mm via annulus wholly outside the solder land: minimum centre offset 2.35 mm exceeds courtyard maximum 2.15 mm.
load_terminal_transfer.process_requirement: Factory-qualified filled/capped via-in-pad, or documented wire-solder process proving full coverage, no wicking and mechanical retention. NOT RUN #65. No supplier/service selected.
load_terminal_transfer.resistance_requirement: Extract actual land, barrel and filled-plane spreading/neck resistance; whole 4.6 A return may use one terminal. Combined branch plus K must remain <=0.5 mOhm. Via-barrel calculation alone is insufficient.
load_terminal_transfer.status: PROPOSAL #38; conditional manufacturing acceptance, not selected service or qualification

surface_ground_strategy.common_resistance_interpretation: Combined branch+K common plane/spreading/shared neck including main-terminal transfer <=0.5 mOhm. Individual GH access paths are separately extracted and added to every alternative return in conductance-extrema bound; candidate own PCB/contact resistance remains zero.
surface_ground_strategy.geometry: Same outline, real source keepouts/reservations and all existing copper/hardware unchanged. Measure actual filled continuity. Prefer native surface-pour main-land and GH contact access through existing plated AGND sleeves/vias before using solder-land arrays.
